section.content: The utility model relates to the technical field of gene detection and discloses a biological gene detection probe which comprises a detection probe body, a wireless transmission module, a threaded cylinder, a screw rod, a knob, a threaded ring, a medical cotton ball, a transfusion tube, a limiting ring, a rubber sleeve and a fixing belt. This biological gene detection probe can be with screwed ring and screw thread section of thick bamboo threaded connection, and with screwed ring rotation to spacing ring department, after the probe body finishes using, through utilizing the syringe to input medical alcohol in to the transfer line, let medical cotton group absorb, the rethread rotatory knob makes the screw rod rotatory in the screw thread section of thick bamboo to drive probe body to screw thread section of thick bamboo internal contraction, the shrink in-process, the probe body can rotate simultaneously with medical cotton group contact, make the medical cotton group that absorbs medical alcohol can clear up the probe body, and can dismantle the screwed ring and change medical cotton group, make probe body repeatedly usable, and be difficult for influencing the detection.

本实用新型涉及基因检测技术领域，且公开了一种生物基因检测探针，包括检测探针，检测探针包括探针本体、无线传输模块、螺纹筒、螺杆、旋钮、螺纹环、医用棉团、输液管、限位环、橡胶套和固定带。该生物基因检测探针可将螺纹环与螺纹筒螺纹连接，且将螺纹环旋转至限位环处，当探针本体使用完毕后，通过利用注射器向输液管中输入医用酒精，让医用棉团吸收，再通过旋转旋钮使螺杆于螺纹筒中旋转，从而带动探针本体向螺纹筒内收缩，收缩过程中，探针本体会一边旋转一边与医用棉团接触，使吸收医用酒精的医用棉团可对探针本体进行清理，且可将螺纹环拆卸对医用棉团进行更换，让探针本体可重复使用，且不易影响探测。

Biological gene detection probeTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a biological gene detection probe.

Background

The gene is a basic unit of inheritance, DNA or RNA sequence carrying genetic information, the genetic information is transferred to the next generation through replication, the synthesis of protein is guided to express the genetic information carried by the gene, so as to control the property expression of biological individuals, the gene detection is a technology for detecting DNA through blood, other body fluids or cells, the peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person are taken, after the gene information is amplified, the DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person is detected through specific equipment, and the type of the gene contained in the gene and whether the gene defect and the expression function are normal or not are analyzed, so that people can know the gene information of the person, and the cause of the disease is clarified or the risk of the body suffering from a certain disease is predicted.

The existing gene probe needs to be repeatedly used when directly contacting a sample to be measured, so that cost is saved, but the repeatedly used needle leads to difference in detection result, the effectiveness of detection data is affected, the practicability of the equipment is reduced, the quality of the product in use is not guaranteed, and the needle is easy to damage during cleaning.

Disclosure of Invention

(one) solving the technical problems

Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the utility model provides a biological gene detection probe which comprises a knob, a screw rod, a limiting ring, a threaded ring, a medical cotton ball and a transfusion tube, wherein the threaded ring can be in threaded connection with a threaded tube, and is rotated to the limiting ring.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present utility model provides the following technical solutions: the biological gene detection probe comprises a detection probe body, a wireless transmission module, a threaded cylinder, a screw rod, a knob, a threaded ring, a medical cotton ball, a transfusion tube, a limiting ring, a rubber sleeve and a fixing belt;

the medical cotton swab is characterized in that a screw is arranged on the inner wall of the threaded cylinder, a knob is arranged at one end of the screw, a limiting ring is arranged on the arc-shaped surface of the threaded cylinder, a threaded ring is arranged on the arc-shaped surface of the threaded cylinder, a medical cotton swab is arranged on the inner wall of the threaded ring, and a transfusion tube is arranged on the arc-shaped surface of the threaded ring.

Preferably, the screw is connected with the inner wall of the screw tube in a threaded manner, the knob is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the screw, the probe body is fixedly arranged at one end of the screw, the probe body is electrically connected with the wireless transmission module, and the connecting wire penetrates through the screw and the knob.

Through the technical scheme, the screw rod and the inner wall of the threaded cylinder can be rotated through the knob, so that the probe body can move.

Preferably, the arc surface of the threaded cylinder is fixedly provided with a rubber sleeve.

Through the technical scheme, when the threaded cylinder is released from hands and falls, the rubber sleeve can reduce the impact force received by the probe body.

Preferably, the arc surface of the thread cylinder is provided with a rectangular bulge, the rectangular bulge penetrates through the rubber sleeve, the surface of the rectangular bulge is provided with a connecting hole in a penetrating mode, and the fixing belt is connected with the thread cylinder through the connecting hole of the rectangular bulge.

Through the technical scheme, the fixing belt can be sleeved on the arm when the screw thread cylinder is used, and the screw thread cylinder is prevented from being out of hand.

Preferably, the arc surface of the threaded cylinder is provided with threads, the upper end of the threads on the arc surface is fixedly provided with a limiting ring, the threads on the arc surface of the threaded cylinder are connected with threaded rings, medical cotton masses are adhered to the inner wall of the threaded rings, the medical cotton masses block the openings of the threaded rings, the arc surface of the threaded rings is provided with an infusion port in a penetrating mode, and the inner wall of the infusion port is fixedly provided with an infusion tube.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme for can with screwed ring and screw thread section of thick bamboo threaded connection, and with screwed ring rotation to spacing ring department, after the probe body uses, through utilizing the syringe to input medical alcohol in to the transfer line, let medical cotton group absorb, rethread rotatory knob makes the screw rod rotatory in the screw thread section of thick bamboo, thereby drive probe body to screw thread section of thick bamboo internal contraction, the shrink in-process, the probe body can rotate and contact with medical cotton group simultaneously, make the medical cotton group that absorbs medical alcohol can clear up the probe body, and can dismantle the screwed ring and change medical cotton group.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a biological gene detection probe, which comprises the following components

The beneficial effects are that:

1. according to the utility model, the threaded ring is in threaded connection with the threaded cylinder through the knob, the screw rod, the limiting ring, the threaded ring, the medical cotton and the infusion tube, and the threaded ring is rotated to the limiting ring, after the probe body is used, medical alcohol is input into the infusion tube through the syringe, so that the medical cotton is absorbed, the screw rod is rotated in the threaded cylinder through the rotation of the knob, and the probe body is driven to shrink inwards of the threaded cylinder, and in the shrinking process, the probe body can rotate and contact with the medical cotton at the same time, so that the medical cotton absorbing the medical alcohol can be cleaned on the probe body, the threaded ring can be detached to replace the medical cotton, the probe body can be reused, and detection is not affected easily.

2. According to the utility model, the rubber sleeve and the fixing belt are adopted, so that the fixing belt can be sleeved on the arm during use, the thread cylinder is prevented from being out of hand, and the rubber sleeve can reduce the impact force applied to the probe body when the thread cylinder is out of hand and falls down.

Drawings

FIG. 2 is a schematic top view of a threaded cylinder according to the present utility model;

FIG. 3 is a schematic view of the bottom surface of the threaded ring of the present utility model.

Wherein: 1. detecting a probe; 2. a probe body; 3. a wireless transmission module; 4. a thread cylinder; 5. a screw; 6. a knob; 7. a threaded ring; 8. medical cotton balls; 9. an infusion tube; 10. a limiting ring; 11. a rubber sleeve; 12. a fixing belt.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present utility model will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present utility model, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the utility model without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the utility model.

Referring to fig. 1-3, a biological gene detection probe comprises a detection probe 1, wherein the detection probe 1 comprises a probe body 2, a wireless transmission module 3, a threaded cylinder 4, a screw 5, a knob 6, a threaded ring 7, a medical cotton ball 8, a transfusion tube 9, a limiting ring 10, a rubber sleeve 11 and a fixing belt 12;

the inner wall of the threaded cylinder 4 is provided with a screw rod 5, one end of the screw rod 5 is provided with a knob 6, the arc-shaped surface of the threaded cylinder 4 is provided with a limiting ring 10, the arc-shaped surface of the threaded cylinder 4 is provided with a threaded ring 7, the inner wall of the threaded ring 7 is provided with a medical cotton ball 8, and the arc-shaped surface of the threaded ring 7 is provided with a transfusion tube 9.

Specifically, screw section of thick bamboo 4 inner wall threaded connection has screw rod 5, and screw rod 5 top surface fixed mounting has knob 6, and screw rod 5 one end fixed mounting has probe body 2, and probe body 2 and wireless transmission module 3 electric connection, and the connecting wire runs through screw rod 5 and knob 6. Advantageously, the screw 5 and the inner wall of the screw cylinder 4 are rotated by the knob 6, so that the probe body 2 can be moved.

Specifically, the arc surface of the thread cylinder 4 is fixedly provided with a rubber sleeve 11. The advantage is that when the screw thread cylinder 4 is taken off and falls, the rubber sleeve 11 can reduce the impact force received by the probe body 2.

Specifically, the arc surface of the screw thread cylinder 4 is provided with a rectangular bulge, the rectangular bulge penetrates through the rubber sleeve 11, the rectangular bulge surface penetrates through to be provided with a connecting hole, and the fixing belt 12 is connected with the screw thread cylinder 4 through the rectangular bulge connecting hole. The advantage is that the fixing belt 12 can be sleeved on the arm when in use, and the thread cylinder 4 is prevented from being out of hand.

Specifically, the arc surface of the thread cylinder 4 is provided with threads, the upper end of the threads on the arc surface is fixedly provided with a limiting ring 10, the threads on the arc surface of the thread cylinder 4 are connected with a thread ring 7 in a threaded manner, a medical cotton group 8 is stuck on the inner wall of the thread ring 7, the medical cotton group 8 blocks the opening of the thread ring 7, the arc surface of the thread ring 7 is provided with an infusion port in a penetrating manner, and an infusion tube 9 is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the infusion port. The advantage is, make can be with screw thread ring 7 and screw thread section of thick bamboo 4 threaded connection, and with screw thread ring 7 rotatory to spacing ring 10 departments, after probe body 2 finishes using, through utilizing the syringe to input medical alcohol in to transfer line 9, let medical cotton group 8 absorb, rethread rotatory knob 6 makes screw rod 5 rotatory in screw thread section of thick bamboo 4, thereby drive probe body 2 to screw thread section of thick bamboo 4 internal contraction, in-process, probe body 2 can rotate and contact with medical cotton group 8 simultaneously, make the medical cotton group 8 that absorbs medical alcohol clear up probe body 2, and can dismantle screw thread ring 7 and change medical cotton group 8.

When the medical cotton swab is used, the threaded ring 7 is in threaded connection with the threaded cylinder 4, the threaded ring 7 is rotated to the position of the limiting ring 10, detection is carried out through the probe body 2, detection data can be transmitted through the wireless transmission module 3, the fixing belt 12 can be sleeved on an arm during use, the threaded cylinder 4 is prevented from being out of hand, after the probe body 2 is used, medical alcohol is input into the infusion tube 9 through the syringe, the medical cotton swab 8 is absorbed, the screw 5 is rotated in the threaded cylinder 4 through the rotary knob 6, the probe body 2 is driven to shrink inwards in the threaded cylinder 4, the probe body 2 can rotate and contact with the medical cotton swab 8 in the shrinking process, the medical cotton swab 8 absorbing the medical alcohol can clean the probe body 2, and the threaded ring 7 can be detached to replace the medical cotton swab 8.

Although embodiments of the present utility model have been shown and described, it will be understood by those skilled in the art that various changes, modifications, substitutions and alterations can be made therein without departing from the principles and spirit of the utility model, the scope of which is defined in the appended claims and their equivalents.
